descriptors.concept_name: Role of Lean Production System as Sub-Set or Support System to PMS
descriptors.definition: Lean production is a management philosophy focused on eliminating waste and unnecessary activities to deliver the right items to the correct locations on schedule. This approach acts as a support system to performance measurement by driving continuous operational improvements.
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from quality in MIS, which focuses on data characteristics like accuracy and timeliness rather than physical production waste reduction.

descriptors.definition: High-quality information enables management to make informed decisions and effectively control operations and performance. This quality depends on functional and reliable systems that ensure data attributes such as reliability, accuracy, timeliness, objectivity, and completeness.
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from lean production systems by focusing strictly on information characteristics and MIS functionality rather than physical operational waste.
